decision: D-176 serving budget: how many judgments (J) and candidate paragraphs each (P) the 8B chooser scores
written: 2026-11-27, before any budget below J=10, P=7 was computed
data: precedent dev v2 GPU pool (ds-para-gpu) and its 8B scores (out-paragpu); judgments beyond J keep search's paragraph
rule: the budget with the fewest mean pairs per question whose paragraph@10 is within 2.1 points (one case of 48) of the full chooser (J=10, P=7) AND whose paired 95% CI against search's paragraph stays above 0; ties: fewer pairs, then smaller J
then: the chosen budget is the one read on test (paragraph-chooser-test), computed from the same test scores
